note: Dispositions recorded on the morning of 1 Oct 2026, before the investor estimate goes out on 2 Oct. Loaded with `python -m fundops seed`; cleared with `python -m fundops reset`. Dispositions: APPROVE = accept the treatment proposed; REJECT = do not accept the figure/instruction as presented; WAIVE = accept the risk, no action; ESCALATE = decision belongs above the Controller; REQUEST_INFO = cannot be closed without something from outside; NOTE = acknowledged, no decision needed.

decisions.rationale: Phone Wrenfield client reporting this morning; email has not worked and they told us on 2 Sep they are changing systems. Estimate goes out with the sleeve carried at August close ($8.719M, 11.0% of master) and this disclosed in one sentence. Final NAV on 14 Oct does not get struck without the statement. T. Reeve informed.

Query to Stonebow ops: bridge August close $10,893,000 to their opening $10,708,000 — we have no record of a $185,000 withdrawal. Estimate uses their reported closing ($10,951,072, the lower figure) and discloses the $189,199 range. If the $185,000 did leave the sleeve, we need to know where it went; if it didn't, their statement is wrong and we need a reissue before final.

22 days' notice against 30 required. Processing it means the GP is waiving notice for one investor; that is a GP/legal decision with equal-treatment implications, not an ops one. Until a waiver is documented, Lanyard is instructed to hold the trade, the base-case estimate shows Offshore pre-redemption, and Kestrel Point is told today that the request is received and the dealing date is under review. The alternative (processed as queued) is in the roll-forward so the decision is a one-line change.

Signed form says $2,556,000 for 15 Sep; $2,404,000 arrived on 19 Sep. We cannot allot $2,404,000 against a $2,556,000 instruction without an amended instruction, and the money arrived after the dealing date anyway. Funds held in the subscription account, excluded from NAV. Call Dana Whitmore today: is $152,000 coming, or is the subscription $2,404,000 for the next dealing date? Lanyard told the subscription is not allotted for September.

Foxglove's own note says the fee was computed on closing NAV at a quarterly rate. The schedule is 1.25% p.a. on average NAV, monthly: $9,420, not $28,546. Closing NAV accepted for the estimate (the error makes it conservative); the $19,126 overcharge goes back to Foxglove for a corrected statement and is tracked for recovery.

Sleeve is below its $9,210,000 HWM; no incentive accrues under the schedule. Harrowgate accrued $14,878 as '15% of monthly net gain'. Figures came by email with the formal statement 'to follow'. Reported closing used in the estimate (conservative); corrected formal statement requested from their administrator before final.

Confirmation to Lanyard goes today with exactly these dispositions: Bellhaven $724,000 allotted to Select LP for 15 Sep (signed form to follow); Alderbrook not allotted, funds held; Kestrel Point redemption held pending GP decision on notice.

Wire matches the instruction to the dollar, arrived three days before dealing, existing investor in the vehicle. Allot for 15 Sep. Signed additional-subscription form must be on file before final NAV — Bellhaven asked today.

Use the Caldera Ridge sleeve return (1.42%) as the proxy for the $3.113M direct position in the estimate and say so in the Select LP note. Request the co-investment statement from Caldera Ridge; it should be on the same monthly cadence as the sleeve.

Twenty business days is unacceptable for an advisor with two clients in the vehicle. Reply today: redemption terms from the register (monthly, 30 days' notice); August vehicle-level return requested from Lanyard because the package does not contain it. Ask Lanyard to add vehicle-level returns to every package from September.

Closing agrees, so September's opening is unaffected. But the package says August was reconciled to manager statements and this one wasn't — Lanyard to explain which figure they reconciled to. Matters more because Wrenfield is also the sleeve with no September statement.
Numbers tie on every check. 'Estimate (final)' in a subject line is sloppy, not wrong. Ask for the statement document for the final NAV file.
Not a September-close item but it is three weeks old. Reply with dates this week; rep letter comments are overdue.
Counterparty master updated so October chasers go to accounts@juniperlane.
The system infers the unit from the NAV movement and records it; no figure was mis-scaled. Ask Tidewater to label the column.
Pull the September bank statement from the Granite Harbor portal before final; immaterial to the estimate.
